name: promotion-agreement
title: Promotion agreement
for_each: select id,ref from promotions where status in ('proposed','agreed') order by ref

sections.title: Products and deal rates
sections.note: Per unit, excluding GST. Off-invoice comes off the invoice on the promotional order; scan is claimed on units sold.
sections.sql: select sku,product,currency,shelf_cents,promo_shelf_cents,list_cents,off_invoice_cents,scan_cents,net_cents,forecast_units,ordered_units,final_units from line_work where promotion_id=$1 order by sku

sections.title: Funding
sections.note: The supplier funds this promotion as set out here and no further.

name: claim-query
title: Claim query
for_each: select id,ref from claims where status='disputed' or id in (select c.id from claims c join compliance_findings f on f.ref=c.ref or f.ref like c.ref||' and %' or f.ref like '% and '||c.ref) order by ref

sections.title: The promotion it was matched to
sections.sql: select promotion,instore_start,instore_end,currency,expected_cents from claim_work where id=$1 and promotion is not null

sections.title: Why we are querying it
sections.sql: select f.rule,f.finding from compliance_findings f join claims c on f.ref=c.ref or f.ref like c.ref||' and %' or f.ref like '% and '||c.ref where c.id=$1 order by f.rule

name: accrual-schedule
title: Trade accrual schedule
for_each: select distinct c.id,c.name from customers c join promo_totals t on t.customer_id=c.id where t.phase in ('live','completed') and t.status='agreed' order by c.name

sections.title: Accrued, claimed and open
sections.note: For month end. Scan funding is accrued on scan units where the retailer has sent them, forecast units where not.
sections.sql: select a.ref,a.phase,a.instore_start,a.instore_end,a.currency,a.accrued_cents,a.claimed_cents,a.open_cents,a.basis from accruals a join customers c on c.code=a.customer_code where c.id=$1 order by a.instore_start

sections.title: Claims not yet matched
sections.sql: select ref,retailer_ref,received_on,kind,method,currency,amount_cents,status from claim_work where customer_id=$1 and status='open' and promotion is null order by received_on

name: post-event-report
title: Post-event report
for_each: select id,ref from promotions where id in (select id from promo_totals where phase='completed') order by ref

sections.title: Result
sections.sql: select e.ref,e.customer,e.title,e.mechanic,e.instore_start,e.instore_end,e.baseline_units,e.units,e.uplift_pct,e.currency,e.trade_spend_cents,e.incremental_gp_cents,e.roi from evaluation e join promotions p on p.ref=e.ref where p.id=$1

sections.title: By product
sections.sql: select sku,product,currency,net_cents,margin_pct,baseline_units,forecast_units,actual_units,final_units from line_work where promotion_id=$1 order by sku

sections.title: Claims against it
sections.sql: select ref,retailer_ref,kind,currency,amount_cents,status from claim_work where promotion_id=$1 order by received_on
